# M-NOISE — why the refusal rule refuses (C17-04)

**Generated by `comparator m-noise` from `results/M-NOISE/L1` and `results/M-NOISE/L2`. Do not edit.** The design is `docs/study/M-NOISE-design.md`, committed before any run. One cell: single currency, 10⁴ accounts, P+ against P-inc, q1 p50 and p99 at 1, 2 and 4 clients, seeds 1, 7, 42, 100 and 2024; each (seed, metric) judged by `stats::judge`, as E27b's cells are. **L1** is E27b's length (200 operations and 60 reads per client per run, 3 warm-up runs); **L2** doubles both and the warm-up runs (400, 120, 6). Both have 10 measured runs.

**Measured at checkpoint_interval = 16** (E27b's C), as every point's header records.

## Verdict

| length | refused cells (of 30) |
|---|--:|
| L1 (E27b's) | 12 |
| L2 (2×, 2× warm-up) | 14 |

**By the pre-registered rule (design §5): the host is the cause: comparisons at 10⁵ and above move to the Mac (D17-7), and this host keeps 10³–10⁴.**

## Refusals by reason

| length | reason | cells |
|---|---|--:|
| L1 | warm-up MAD above 15% of the median on P+ | 5 |
| L1 | warm-up MAD above 15% of the median on P+ and P-inc | 1 |
| L1 | warm-up MAD above 15% of the median on P-inc | 6 |
| L2 | warm-up MAD above 15% of the median on P+ | 4 |
| L2 | warm-up MAD above 15% of the median on P+ and P-inc | 5 |
| L2 | warm-up MAD above 15% of the median on P-inc | 5 |
